title: AcuitySignalFeatures
description: Feature payload generated by the safety gate / acuity ensemble prior to triage prioritisation.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the signal was computed (UTC).

modelVersion.description: Version identifier of the model producing the scores.

predictedClass.description: Argmax decision from the acuity classifier.

symptomEmbedding.description: Fixed-length embedding derived from symptom/document encoding.

patientAgeYears.description: Patient age in years at the time the feature vector was generated.

comorbidityFlags.description: Map of comorbidity indicators used by the model. Keys follow snake_case ICD topic names.

explanations.description: Model interpretability artefacts (e.g., SHAP style contributions).

contribution.description: Signed contribution toward the emergency decision.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry timestamp (UTC) after which the signal must be recomputed.
